site_name: 2 Marquis Road, Wood Green, London, N22 8JH
description:
The proposed use of the properties at 2B and 2C Marquis Road as supported living households falls within Use Class C3(b), which permits up to six people living together as a single household and receiving care.
The properties are currently in lawful residential use within Use Class C3(a), and the proposed use would remain within Use Class C3, resulting in no material change of use and no development as defined by Section 55 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
The proposal involves no operational development, no external alterations, and no intensification of use beyond that typical of a residential dwelling. The residential and domestic character of the properties would be retained at all times.
The proposed use does not fall within Use Class C2, does not constitute a House in Multiple Occupation, and does not engage any Article 4 Directions.
In accordance with Section 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, the proposed use is therefore lawful and a Certificate of Lawfulness of Proposed Use should be granted.
